versions.name: Camp Watchung
versions.summary: A Patriots' Path Council regional summer day camp for Cub Scout-age boys and girls, set within the wooded Watchung Reservation in Mountainside, New Jersey, with small-group den programming and rank-advancement activities.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from Patriots' Path Council's current Watchung Day Camp registration, a regional Cub Scout day camp at Watchung Reservation actively offered for the 2026 season. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
